configurations.name: moonrage-dungeon-dev
configurations.//: Runs Vite's own bin through node rather than `npm run dev`: `npm` is a shell shim (npm.cmd on Windows) that a launcher spawning the executable directly cannot always resolve, and hardcoding a path to it pins the config to one machine. `node` is on PATH everywhere and the script path is repo-relative, so this entry works unchanged on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
